Business goal: Create one durable root-managed Entity seed record.
Authorization summary: Only authenticated root operators with entity.create may create Entity records.
Harness gate notes: Feature manifest and generated dependency graph required because this adds a feature and v1 route family.
Request contract: Body includes name, description, required featureName and scope, optional resolved identity fields, optional sharedCrossTenantApproved, and optional status. System-managed fields are rejected.
Response contract: Returns Entity with entityId, name, description, resolved repo-generation identity fields, status, createdAt, updatedAt, archivedAt.
Error contract: 400 invalid payload or unapproved shared-cross-tenant scope; 401 unauthenticated; 403 missing capability; 409 duplicate current name.
Cross-feature seams: rootRoles capability checker and rootAuth session middleware
Persistence impact: Create one row in entities plus platform audit event.
Indexes / uniqueness: Primary key entity_id; unique normalized_name where archived_at IS NULL; status, scope, and non-empty checks; indexes on feature_name, entity_key, and scope.
Search / filter model: Create is exact mutation; normalized_name supports duplicate checks; featureName suggestions are persisted as resolved values.
Lifecycle / cleanup rules: No cleanup states in first slice; status may be draft active superseded or archived.
Audit requirement: Successful creates and denied capability attempts audit-visible through platform security.
Privacy / personal data impact: No direct personal data expected in v1.
Required test families: unit; integration; security; audit visibility; persistence
Required TC obligation: TC-ENTITY-UNIT-001; TC-ENTITY-UNIT-002; TC-ENTITY-UNIT-004; TC-ENTITY-UNIT-005; TC-ENTITY-INT-001; TC-ENTITY-SEC-003; TC-ENTITY-INT-002
Audit test posture: success audit covered through platform security event path
Performance/NFR posture: standard pagination NFR not applicable to create
Acceptance notes: Accept when root operator can create a current Entity seed with generated system fields
column108: and duplicate current normalized names are rejected.

Business goal: Read one current or explicitly archived Entity by exact id.
Authorization summary: Only authenticated root operators with entity.read may read Entity records.
Harness gate notes: Archived visibility must be explicit and documented.
Request contract: Exact UUID route param plus optional includeArchived query.
Error contract: 400 invalid id; 401 unauthenticated; 403 missing capability; 404 not found or archived when not opted in.
Cross-feature seams: rootRoles capability checker and rootAuth session middleware
Audit requirement: Denied reads audit-visible; successful reads optional.
Privacy / personal data impact: No direct personal data expected in v1.
Acceptance notes: Accept when normal exact read hides archived records and explicit includeArchived can retrieve retained archived history.

Business goal: List Entity records with repo-standard pagination and approved filters.
Authorization summary: Only authenticated root operators with entity.read may list Entity records.
Harness gate notes: Pagination and filter defaults follow AGENTS defaults.
Request contract: Query supports page, pageSize, orderBy, orderDirection, namePrefix, status, includeArchived, createdAtFrom/To, updatedAtFrom/To.
Response contract: Returns PaginatedEntities with standard totals and stored repo-generation identity fields on each item.
Cross-feature seams: rootRoles capability checker and rootAuth session middleware
Indexes / uniqueness: Indexes on normalized_name, status, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, feature_name, entity_key, and scope.
Search / filter model: Prefix search on normalized name; exact status filter; archived opt-in.
Audit requirement: Denied lists audit-visible; successful reads optional.
Privacy / personal data impact: No direct personal data expected in v1.
Acceptance notes: Accept when list uses standard shape
column108: and excludes archived records by default.

Business goal: Update current Entity metadata and lifecycle status while preserving system-managed fields.
Authorization summary: Only authenticated root operators with entity.update may update current Entity records.
Harness gate notes: Normal update must not edit archived records.
Request contract: Body includes at least one persisted field among name, description, resolved identity fields, scope, or status. System fields are rejected.
Response contract: Returns updated Entity response with stored repo-generation identity fields.
Error contract: 400 invalid payload or unapproved shared-cross-tenant scope; 401 unauthenticated; 403 missing capability; 404 current entity not found; 409 duplicate current name.
Cross-feature seams: rootRoles capability checker and rootAuth session middleware
Persistence impact: Update one current row in entities plus platform audit event.
Indexes / uniqueness: Unique current normalized_name still enforced on rename; stored repo-generation identity fields update only when explicitly supplied.
Lifecycle / cleanup rules: Archived records are not editable through normal update; setting status archived is allowed and sets archivedAt.
Audit requirement: Successful updates and denied capability attempts audit-visible through platform security.
Privacy / personal data impact: No direct personal data expected in v1.
Audit test posture: success audit covered through platform security event path
column109: keeps accepted identity values unless explicitly changed
column110: and cannot mutate archived records normally.

Business goal: Archive a current Entity without hard deleting durable platform self-definition truth.
Authorization summary: Only authenticated root operators with entity.delete may archive Entity records.
Harness gate notes: Delete is archive only because full cleanup states are deferred.
Request contract: Exact UUID route param. No client lifecycle fields accepted.
Response contract: Returns archived Entity with status archived and archivedAt set.
Error contract: 400 invalid id; 401 unauthenticated; 403 missing capability; 404 not found; 409 already archived.
Cross-feature seams: rootRoles capability checker and rootAuth session middleware
Persistence impact: Update status and archived_at on one row plus platform audit event.
Indexes / uniqueness: archived_at index supports explicit archived reads; current unique name releases on archive.
Lifecycle / cleanup rules: Archive retains durable row; hard delete restore pending cleanup and cleanup failure are out of scope.
Audit requirement: Successful archives and denied capability attempts audit-visible through platform security.
Privacy / personal data impact: No direct personal data expected in v1.
Audit test posture: success audit covered through platform security event path
